full_inspection: All four complete native halves of sites035 and111 were inspected line by line, with enlarged copy2 details of both crossed letters and the marginal e. Every original note, macro and D2 row was checked. Each copy2 correction mark and each shared hand mark is recorded at its observed locus.
original_transcription_comparison: The original copy1 transcription silently chose résiduel for typed résidual; checked copy1 restores the a. Original copy2 identifies a correction but places the marginal e inline and leaves the stroke in mais unresolved. Both originals misclassify the two typed partials as hand. These errors are distinguished from the actual copy2 correction layers.

entries.reason: The handwritten e stands to the left of the line containing the canceled a. Together they give the correction résidual to résiduel.
